content.text: {"id": "mm6619a5", "data_focus": {"v": "yes", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Among 2,478 live-born infants delivered at this hospital during 2014, a sample of 971 (39%) was randomly selected"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "The odds of receiving HBsAg screening among women who received prenatal care was significantly higher"}]}, "outcome_types": [{"v": "binary/categorical", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "18 (2%) were HBsAg-positive, of whom 14 were Pacific Islanders and four were Asian"}, {"loc": "summary", "q": "98% received prenatal HBsAg screening, compared with 85% of women who did not receive prenatal care"}]}], "analytic_depth": [{"v": "summary", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Among 899 women with available HBsAg screening result data, 18 (2%) were HBsAg-positive"}]}, {"v": "comparison", "ev": [{"loc": "summary", "q": "98% received prenatal HBsAg screening, compared with 85% of women who did not receive prenatal care"}, {"loc": "summary", "q": "HBsAg seroprevalence (2.0%) was approximately 13 times higher than that among U.S.-born Pacific Islander and Asian women"}]}], "study_design": [{"v": "cross-sectional", "ev": [{"loc": "summary", "q": "In a hospital-based random sample of women with a live birth during 2014 in Guam"}]}], "methods_quotes": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Descriptive analyses and frequencies were performed to calculate the prevalence of prenatal HBsAg screening"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "The odds of receiving HBsAg screening among women who received prenatal care was significantly higher"}], "confidence": "medium", "uncertain_fields": ["study_design"]}
